title: RED ROBIN ANNOUNCES PRELIMINARY THIRD QUARTER COMPARABLE RESTAURANT REVENUE; RESCHEDULES EARNINGS CALL TO NOVEMBER 18, 2026

body_markdown:
ENGLEWOOD, Colo.


, Nov. 2, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Red Robin Gourmet Burgers, Inc. (NASDAQ: RRGB) ("Red Robin" or the "Company"), a casual dining restaurant chain serving an innovative selection of high-quality gourmet burgers in a family-friendly atmosphere, today announced preliminary, unaudited comparable restaurant revenue results for the fiscal third quarter ended October 4, 2026.


**Earnings Release and Conference Call Rescheduled to November 18th**


During the third quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company completed significant refranchising transactions and refinanced its existing debt, representing important milestones in the execution of its strategic plan. Given the complexity of the accounting and valuation analyses associated with these transactions, the Company requires additional time to complete its financial statements and related disclosures.


The Company will reschedule its fiscal third quarter earnings release and conference call to Wednesday, November 18, 2026, which was previously scheduled for November 4, 2026.


The Company noted that the delay is unrelated to any significant changes in its financial condition or results of operations. The rescheduled earnings release and conference call will allow the Company to provide investors with a more comprehensive update on its financial results, the successful execution of these strategic initiatives, continued operational progress during the quarter, and updated guidance outlook under a more franchised ownership model.


The Company announced that it will file a Notification of Late Filing on Form NT 10-Q (the "Form NT 10-Q") with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") under Rule 12b-25 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, to extend the filing deadline for its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended October 4, 2026 (the "Form 10-Q"). The Company expects to file the Form 10-Q within the five-calendar-day extension period permitted under Rule 12b-25.

**Chief Executive Officer Comments**


"Since launching our First Choice Plan in July 2025, we have remained focused on meaningfully strengthening our operating performance and financial position," said Dave Pace, Red Robin's President and Chief Executive Officer. "During the third quarter, we completed three refranchising agreements that generated significant proceeds. These proceeds were used to reduce outstanding debt and support the successful refinancing of our debt on attractive commercial terms. These transactions represent an important milestone for the Company and provide greater financial stability as we continue to execute our First Choice initiatives and advance our long-term strategic priorities."


Mr. Pace continued, "in addition, I am encouraged by the continued momentum in the third quarter, as same-store sales outperformed the industry. The 3.9% increase in same store sales benefited from the success of our Big Yummm value platform, which launched in July 2025. That platform provides an accessible entry point for guests while preserving the full Red Robin experience that guests have come to expect. This performance reinforces our confidence in the First Choice strategy and we remain focused on increasing frequency and engagement by delivering exceptional hospitality and a seamless guest experience. With a stronger financial foundation and improving operating trends, we believe Red Robin is well positioned to execute on its long-term priorities."


**Significant Q3 Transactions**


During the third quarter, the Company completed the refranchising of 108 Company-owned restaurants through three separate transactions with experienced franchise operators, generating approximately $89.4 million in aggregate cash proceeds, subject to customary adjustments. The transactions included 30 restaurants sold to Evergreen Dining LLC, 61 restaurants sold to Op Burgers, LLC, and 17 restaurants sold to Kuber Oregon, LLC and Kuber Washington, LLC.


In addition, the Company completed the refinancing of its secured credit facility on October 2, 2026. The five-year $115 million credit agreement provides for a $25 million revolving line of credit and a $90 million term loan. Interest on the term loan and revolving line of credit is based on SOFR plus 275 to 350 basis points, depending on the Company's leverage ratio, with no SOFR floor. The initial rate is SOFR plus 325 basis points.


These transactions represent a significant milestone in the execution of the Company's First Choice plan, supporting debt reduction, strengthening the balance sheet and expanding the Company's franchise-operated restaurant base.

The conference call can be accessed live over the phone by dialing 201-689-8560 which will be answered by an operator or by clicking[Call Me](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812263-1&h=1128600737&u=https%3A%2F%2Fcallme.viavid.com%2Fviavid%2F%3Fcallme%3Dtrue%26passcode%3D13728550%26h%3Dtrue%26info%3Dcompany%26r%3Dtrue%26B%3D6&a=Call+Me) .
